A shared-market deck-building game

Stories of Sacrifice

Choose four Chronicles. Build your deck, court the Legends, and be the first to claim 40 Glory.

Choose exactly four Chronicles.

How to play

Play cards from your hand to gain Gold and Might. Spend Gold to recruit cards from the Crossroads. Spend Might to defeat enemy Champions; leftover Might becomes Glory when your turn ends.

You may invoke one Legend each turn. A Legend facing you grants Allegiance. End a turn with all four Legends facing you for an immediate victory, or reach 40 Glory and survive the rival's final response.

How the story unfolds

  1. Play cards to generate Gold, Might, and special effects.
  2. Recruit cards from the shared Crossroads with Gold. They enter your Rest pile.
  3. Defeat rival Champions by paying Might equal to their durability. Guards must fall first.
  4. Invoke one Legend per turn if you can pay its cost.
  5. End your turn. Leftover Might becomes Glory and you draw five new cards.

Reach 40 Glory and remain ahead after the rival's response, or control all four Legends at the end of your turn.
